verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents MailerSend generating SPF/DKIM/DMARC DNS records, verifying them, or exposing domain verification status via the API. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: DMARC report monitoring, blocklist monitoring of sending domains, and an MCP server that can 'manage domains' without specifying DNS record generation or verification.

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate my sending domain end to end — the product generates the exact SPF/DKIM/DMARC DNS records, verifies them, and exposes verification status via the API
